description: This file defines the SplashScreen activity for an Android app, responsible for displaying a splash screen on app startup and transitioning to the HomeActivity after a delay.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity class that displays a splash screen for 4 seconds upon app launch, then navigates to the HomeActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. Sets up view binding, modifies window flags to fullscreen, and initiates splash screen delay.

methods.name: splashScreen
methods.description: Handles the splash delay using Handler, then starts HomeActivity and finishes the splash activity.
